name: hr_training_plus
summary: Training providers, budget-approved requests, enrollment attendance, learning paths, exams and graded attempts, certificate-expiry reminders and job-vs-employee skill gap detection
description: Production learning management on top of hr_training without migrating its tables: courses gain a delivery provider and a certificate-validity window, enrollments track attendance and hours attended, and new models add training providers, budget-gated maker-checker training requests, ordered learning paths with mandatory courses, exams with scored questions and graded attempts (percentage and pass derived from the total against the exam's pass mark), a scheduled idempotent scan that surfaces expiring/expiring certificates as alerts, and skill-gap detection comparing each skill a job requires against the level the employee currently holds. Consistent with the blueprint guardrail, approving a request only records a decision and never posts a cost, and grading an attempt is manager-gated. Extends the hr anchor, hr_skill and hr_training; navigated under the single HR app.
author: Nexa
